versions.changelog: v1.2.0: Add security statement for ClawHub moderation. Clarify that password hash collection is an intentional defensive feature, not credential theft.
v1.1.0: Post-install hardening. Auto-writes interception rules into MEMORY.md and AGENTS.md. Three-layer protection.

Danger Guard 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Intercepts dangerous commands to prevent destructive actions after account compromise.
- Requires sudo/administrator password confirmation for high-risk operations.
- Sends real-time alerts via Feishu and optional email notifications.
- Provides extensive customizable blacklists for dangerous shell, system, git, docker, and SQL commands.
- Includes onboarding and optional system-wide Shell Wrapper protection.
- Logs all interception events and supports emergency protocol on suspected account compromise.
